$note: Two MCP servers, both backed by local workspace packages (nothing is published to npm). `attest` is the stdio MCP server from packages/attest-mcp (77 validators + phase_gate_check + route_goal + list_experts), run as `node packages/attest-mcp/dist/cli.js` — run `npm run build:mcp` once after `npm install` to produce the dist. `attest-conductor` is the BDK agent that runs the /autopilot Ralph loop, served out of packages/attest-conductor via @cursor/bdk serve. See .cursor/skills/invoke-attest-conductor/SKILL.md for the three-path dial-out (preferred: MCP tool, fallback: HTTPS, fallback: GitHub comment).

attest.$comment: Workspace sibling — not uploaded to any registry. Build it once with `npm --prefix packages/attest-mcp run build` (or `./scripts/local-install.sh`). ${workspaceFolder} is Cursor-expanded to the project root.

attest-conductor.$comment: Local invocation: served out of packages/attest-conductor via @cursor/bdk serve --mode single. For a Cursor-hosted deploy (after `./scripts/deploy.sh`), swap this stanza for { "url": "https://<slug>/<team>/v1/mcp", "type": "http" } using the slug the deploy returned.
